chunks: The allegiance paid to 'Ali (peace be upon him)
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Bay'ah (allegiance) to Imam Ali in Shia history?
ai.summary: In Shia historiography, this Bay'ah is distinguished from the earlier, more elective pledges of the Sunni tradition, representing the divine appointment (Ismah) and rightful succession of Imam Ali (AS) as the first Imam. It marks the culmination of the Ghadir Khumm declaration, transitioning Ali from a companion to the sole legitimate authority (Imam) and Caliph, thereby establishing the foundation of the Imamate.
